Ethan (AE): Heads up: RetailCo wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Ask list from procurement: signed deliverables, SBOM, customer-held signing key option, no automatic updates, quarterly model refreshes, and a one-page operator runbook. They want commercial options that avoid monthly invoices. Kickoff next Tue.
Rupa (SE): Noted. First clarifying Qs: target model (7B vs 13B), quantization (q4 vs q2), and whether they need delta-only patches or accept full-replace bundles. These drive transfer size and install time.
Kai (Infra Eng): Tech constraints summary: 7B q4 ~600MB, 13B q4 ~1.1GB, runtime & operator ~350MB. Full bundle ~1.5GB. We support chunked minibundles (delta) to reduce transfer. Delivery options: encrypted USB (sneakernet), SFTP to a jumpbox, or airgapped transfer via vetted courier. Transfer times: on 50Mbps ~4 minutes per 100MB. Flag: very slow sites will need minibundles. :package: \nZoe (Solutions Eng): Commercial options to propose in the deck: A) Annual subscription (private deployment) + reserved capacity; includes 4 minibundles/year and 2 support assist installs; invoiced annually to satisfy procurement. B) Perpetual license + annual maintenance invoiced annually + per-bundle engineering fee. C) Fixed-term SOW (12 months) with monthly cadence for security patches but invoiced quarterly. Which approach aligns with sales?
Ethan (AE): They prefer not to see monthly invoices. Let's prioritize options A and B and make sure we show clear per-bundle economics. Also they asked for guaranteed manual-only upgrade policy. Can we commit?
Rupa (SE): Yes. Air-gapped POCs are manual apply only. CLI supports `--verify` and `--apply` flags. Sample: `./rw-offline apply --bundle /media/usb/retail-minibundle.tar.gz --verify-signature`. Rollback: snapshot-based rollback available but operator-triggered. No forced remote pulls.
Kai (Infra Eng): Signing key custody: we can support customer-managed signing keys. Two flows: 1) customer signs bundles locally (they keep private key) and provides public key fingerprint to us; 2) we sign and provide signed artifact if customer allows vendor-signed. If customer-held keys, Legal needs to sign off on verification handshake & offboarding steps. Also recommend an HSM for private key storage; we can provide a short HSM checklist.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): SBOM/provenance: we produce SPDX SBOMs for every bundle and an audit CSV with sha256 fingerprints and signer fingerprint. Example snippet we can include in questionnaire answers: `artifact: redwood-13b-q4-v1.0.tar.gz, sha256: f1e2d3..., sbom: redwood-13b-v1.0.sbom.json, signer: key-fp: aa:bb:cc`
Ethan (AE): They also asked about telemetry/phone-home. RetailCo requires telemetry opt-out. Are we OK to ship with telemetry disabled and still meet support needs?
Rupa (SE): Yes — we support telemetry opt-out for Private/On-Prem. Caveat: remote diagnostics are limited; we offer paid remote-assist sessions for installs/troubleshooting. We'll list tradeoffs in the SOW.
ops-bot: Created ticket SALES-9001 "RetailCo airgap POC - packaging, signing & cadence" assigned to Rupa, Zoe.
Kai (Infra Eng): Operational risks to call out in proposal: 1) bandwidth and physical transfer logistics for >1GB artifacts; 2) need for on-site operator with sudo; 3) key custody & offboarding; 4) patch delta compatibility matrix (we must test minibundle compatibility across their pinned model/runtime versions). Recommend a pre-POC compatibility test on a staging image.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Proposed SOW anchors: - Security patches: monthly prepare, customer applies in their scheduled window (we can set "first Tuesday") but for billing we can offer quarterly invoicing. - Model refresh: quarterly signed minibundles, scheduled "first Tuesday of quarter". - Support: 3 remote assist installs included, additional on-site or remote at day-rate. - Telemetry: opt-out allowed; remote assist billed if telemetry disabled.
Ethan (AE): Action list: Zoe to draft two proposal variants (Annual subscription + Perpetual license) and SOW language with explicit calendar anchors; Rupa to produce minibundle size table + sample `rw-offline` commands & minimal runbook (1p); Kai to prepare HSM/key custody checklist and note Legal dependencies. I'll consolidate and send to RetailCo before end of week.
Rupa (SE): I'll include an install time table with approximations for 10Mbps/50Mbps/100Mbps links and the three bundle flavors: model-only, runtime+model, full bundle. Also will include q4->q2 note (smaller but requires eval signoff).
Kai (Infra Eng): ETA 48h for HSM checklist and Legal touchpoints.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Drafts targeted EOD Thursday.
Ethan (AE): Thanks everyone, please ping if anything is a no-go. :white_check_mark:
